en: The Battle for Arathi Basin will begin in 1 minute.
%s takes aim...
We'll be notching our axes after this.
Mist! I feared I would never see you again! Yes, I am well, do not worry for me. You must rest and recover your health.
Your will is not strong enough to manipulate the forces we control $c.
Come, little ones. Face me!
The stables are full again! Our cavalry is soon to ride!
The Temple of the Moon is home to the priests of Elune.  There you will find Jandria and Lariia, who will provide you with further guidance in the path of priesthood.
There is a mailbox located conveniently right between the Stormwind Bank and The Gilded Rose Inn in the Trade District.

<High Inquisitor Fairbanks shakes his head.>$B$BNo... He stood in the background, watching as the legion of undead descended upon us. Soon after, my powers were exhausted. I was the first to fall... Surely they would tear me limb from limb as I lay there unconscious; but they ignored me completely, focusing all of their attention on the Highlord.
%s sees the Overseer die and runs in fear!
While we have no Alchemy Trainer here in Bloodhoof Village, there is one in Thunder Bluff to the north.  Follow the road there and ask one of the Bluffwatchers for directions when you get to the top.
It's all guns and flames until someone loses and dies.
The spirits told me you would come, that you would seek me for some reason, but that even you may not know that reason. So, do you know why you are here?

Hey, that reminds me, I need to have my rocket boots repaired.  Word to the wise my friend, rocket boots and gryphons don't mix.  

Oh, but you need directions...  just head on over to the Dwarven District, you'll find Lilliam Sparkspindle towards the back.
It has been a long time, Bethor, my friend.
Brace yourself for the glorious impact, Impsy!

No, not that I can tell. It seems to be mostly based on region. Some races have labled them slimes, some oozes. It seems to be preference mostly.$B$BEvery time I've encountered ooze, sludge, or slime they have basically been the same creatures. The differences seem to be based on their environment, which is why we need a pure sample.
Ah, you're looking for Lucan Cordell.  He runs a shop on the outside of the Magic Quarter on your way to the Stockade.
Welcome back, $n.  You've proven a worthy ally against Ragnaros and your presence is always welcome among us.
The Dark Iron dwarves of the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge have a great number of locked boxes.

Are you reporting for duty, $c? All of the war materiel for both the Horde and the Alliance is completed and being shipped to Silithus as we speak. It should all arrive in less than a day. I hope that someone has found the different pieces of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands and put them all together.
%s is drawn to the ghost magnet...
Who controls the Dun Baldar South Bunker?
In grizzly times a druid can be a dear friend to those around them.  Ask any of the druids in the Cenarion Enclave and they will tell you the same.
Need a little help here.  That $n saw me.
Chugga-chugga, woo-woo!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!

It was during the Elemental Sundering that the Firelord, Ragnaros, would seek to consume my Lord, Thunderaan, Prince of Air.$B$B<Demitrian bows his head, his face contorted in rage.>$B$BSpeak his name and I shall decorate this ravaged camp with your entrails. Be silent and listen.
Charog likes to spend his coin at the Busted Drum. Let's go pay him a visit, $n.
